note: The controlling witness explicitly combines the proper antiphon and psalm verse (p. 477), the same edition's full Gloria (p. 1) and its printed antiphon-repetition instructions. The digital comparison is the Statuit introit of its Common, not its own 22 February assignment (In virtute tua); the Liber Usualis compares the antiphon and verse. Apart from the declared Paschaltide Alleluias, the witnesses agree substantively; the actual spelling, accent and punctuation differences are recorded below.
